After 2 days, I got call for the interview.

**Round 2: (Machine coding round)**

* Duration: 3 hrs.
* This round is essentially about resolving a real-world design problem. The task assigned to me was to create a calendar application that schedules meetings, displays different users' calendars, and allows users to accept or reject meetings. It's similar to creating a Google Meet calendar.
* There was an interviewer available. He was extremely helpful, and he even extended the duration because this round was only blocked for an hour.
* At the end of two hours, I had not completed all seven of the requirements given to me, but he looked into my design further and also asked my design for the remaining requirements that I had not completed. We had a good discussion about various extra requirements that lasted about an hour.
* The code should be working at the end without any errors.
* I had the next round on the same day.

**Round 3: (Data structures and algorithms)**

* Duration: 1 hr.
* 3 questions. The approach, time & space complexity, optimization if any were all discussed. I solved only 2 of them but still was selected for the next round.
* Question 1: A 2D matrix is given we need to find a unique path while there is a obstacle. <https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/unique-paths-in-a-grid-with-obstacles/>
* Question 2: This was the standard question of travelling salesman problem using greed method. <https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/travelling-salesman-problem-greedy-approach/>
* Question 3 : A binary tree is given and we need to print all the nodes that are seen from the top. <https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/print-nodes-top-view-binary-tree/>

**Round 4: (Hiring Manager round)**

* Duration: 1 hr.
* He asked me about the specifics of my project and we had a few discussions about it. He asked few questions on my technical skills that I have mentioned on my resume & also the best practices and few behavioral questions.
* It was more like a conversation more than an interview.

# Swiggy Interview Experience for SDE-1 (Bangalore 1.5 Years Experienced)

Last Updated : 23 Jul, 2025

**Online Coding Test (Hackerrank):** Questions were of Easy, Medium, and Hard level, 4 questions in total you need to solve in 1.5 hrs.

**Round 1(On-site, virtual):**

1. Collect maximum points in a grid when you move from top left to bottom right. You can only move towards right and in downward direction. The grid can contain both positive and negative values. Both the approach and the code were expected.
2. [Find the Lowest common ancestor of a binary tree.]( https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/lowest-common-ancestor-binary-tree-set-1/)
3. [Find the maximum contiguous sum in the array.](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/largest-sum-contiguous-subarray/)

**Round 2 (On-site, Virtual):**

1. Space optimization and calculation related question : How will you store the pin codes of different locations with the location name and their respective Pincode. Discussed different approaches and complexities.
2. [Alien Dictionary problem]( https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/given-sorted-dictionary-find-precedence-characters/ ). Asked for the failure conditions in the solution and the approach
3. [Building Bridges problem.](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/dynamic-programming-building-bridges/)
4. Given function f6(), that returns the number between 1 and 6 randomly. All the numbers are returned with equal probability, how will you write f12() function using f6(), which will return the numbers randomly between 1 and 12, all with the same probability.

**Hint:** think of making f3() function then, try making f12() function.

**Round 4 (Hiring Manager round):**

sources.passage:
Swiggy | SDE-1 | Accepted | 1 yoe
Hi all. I applied for **Swiggy SDE-1** via LinkedIn in July 2024.  Got my interviews scheduled in August and my joining is in Sept. Below is brief overview of the process.

*Round 1*
It was a DSA round. I was asked two questions. One question was minimum platforms required by the trains. Second question was rain water trapping problem. The interviewer was very senior and was co-operative. 

*Round 2*
It was a LLD round. The question was to design splitwise application. The interviewer gave me specifications for the question and asked me the Objects, Classes, actors, relations etc. Fully functional code was not expected. I was not able to complete the full solution which was required but then still I advanced to the next round.

*Round 3*
It was a managerial round. We started with project discussion, the interviewer was a IITD alumus and was at a director level. He was having sound technical knowledge and was asking questions in depth. Later he asked me to design databases and API endpoints on one of the internal tools I have developed which I mentioned it in my resume. There was also some of the managerial questions that were asked like why are you switching etc so be prepared for them too.

Verdict: I was selected. 

Will link the compensation post in the comments. 

Stats: I am from a tier-1 college, working as a SDET at a big firm from past 9 months. 
max LC rating: 2200+

Feel free to comment down your questions, I will answer them.

**Upvote, if you find it useful**
